title: Restore safe upgrades and project lookup indexes
instruction: After updating, existing work databases reject migration checksums. New databases still need fast mission and history lookups by workspace and project. Please make upgrades work again without changing previously applied schema steps, and ensure both existing and new databases receive the lookup indexes exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: Previously applied project-record migration bytes remain compatible with existing databases.
Mission and history lookup indexes are introduced once through a new migration.
Main and jobs migration ledgers remain independently enumerable in ordinal order.
